description: Wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-05-22T18:10:53) into the approval_workflow daemon. snow_connector.py provides ServiceNow integration functions; approval_workflow.py (protected) processes MCP submission decisions. This module reads pending decisions from mcp_decisions where status='PENDING' and exports relevant records to ServiceNow via snow_connector write methods. Uses write_service at :8772 for DB access (not direct duckdb). Exposes function process_pending_decisions() that: (1) queries mcp_decisions WHERE status='PENDING'; (2) calls snow_connector methods to create/update SN records; (3) updates mcp_decisions status to 'EXPORTED'. No HTTP between daemons — uses write_service exclusively. Depends on: snow_connector.py (already built), approval_workflow.py (protected — do not modify).
